label: Shemaiah

text.BHSA NEH 12:7: סַלּ֣וּ עָמֹ֔וק חִלְקִיָּ֖ה יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֧י הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם בִּימֵ֥י יֵשֽׁוּעַ׃ פ
text.KJV NEH 12:7: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

A.name: Shemaiah
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:8)

B.name: Shemaiah
B.line: Priest who returned from exile with Zerubbabel, head of a priestly house

why: שְׁמַעְיָה appears in the priestly list that verse 7 identifies as the chief priests in Jeshua’s days, matching B’s stated role and period. A’s covenant-signing identification and the shared Jehonathan relationship do not outweigh that contextual match.
